# AWS CodeCommit git hosting

**Status: future extensions.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Git smart HTTP hosting, branch and commit APIs and EventBridge state events are implemented. SSH transport, triggers and repository seeding remain.

## Proposed scope

- [x] Git HTTP Smart Transfer protocol (/v1/repos/<name>/info/refs, git-upload-pack, git-receive-pack)
- [ ] SSH transport and public key management
- [x] Branch management, default branch configuration, and commit APIs
- [x] CloudWatch Events (EventBridge) repository state change events
- [ ] Trigger execution
- [ ] Code package seeding for CloudFormation AWS::CodeCommit::Repository
- [ ] Pull requests, approval rules and merges
